member.name: T:BlazorMHD.UI.Core.Services.MhdJsInterop
member.summary: Lazily imports the BlazorMHD.UI JavaScript as an ES module and proxies interop calls to it. Because the module is fetched on first use via dynamic import(), consumers no longer need to add a <script src="_content/BlazorMHD.UI/js/BlazorMHDUI.js"> tag to their host page — registering the services with AddBlazorMhdUI() is enough. (The module still assigns a window.BlazorMHDUI global; to use it directly, load the file with <script type="module"> rather than a classic script tag.)
member.remarks: Registered as scoped, so the imported module reference lives for the duration of the user's circuit (Blazor Server) or app instance (WebAssembly) and is released on disposal. The import is started lazily on the first call rather than in the constructor, so injecting the service during static prerender (where JS interop is unavailable) does not throw.
